snippet.title: HISTORY OF THE HOOD: CALI EDITION
snippet.description:
Welcome to History of the Hood: Cali Edition 
Dive deep into the hidden history of California’s notorious gangs and prison gangs. Our channel uncovers the origins, evolution, and impact of these groups on society. From street gangs to prison yards, we explore the stories, culture, and key figures that shaped this underground world.
What You'll Find on This Channel:
- Detailed histories of California’s most infamous gangs
- In-depth profiles of gang leaders and influential figures
- First-hand accounts, interviews, and documentary-style episodes
Our mission is to provide a comprehensive and educational look at this complex and often misunderstood aspect of California's history. Whether you’re a history buff, a student, or just curious, our channel offers insights that are both informative and engaging.
Join us on this journey to uncover the untold stories and real-life experiences from the streets to the prisons of California.

snippet.title: How to Survive Show
snippet.description:
Real people. Extreme disasters. Devastating consequences. Expert analysis. 

We explore gripping stories of humans pushed to their limits to satisfy your curiosity about the true and unrevealed costs of survival from an everyday perspective.

Join our host and resident survivalist Jarred as he uncovers some of the most dangerous real-world events in human history on How to Survive. From animal attacks and natural disasters to man-made disasters and deadly prisons, each episode examines what went wrong and what it took to survive.

Produced by the makers of What If, this channel combines true stories, disaster analysis, survival tactics, and human psychology.

👉 Subscribe for weekly videos on survival stories, disasters, and real-life emergencies.
